{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"000000000000089YX1WEYQMRYJ","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
group echo "ECHO" {
  node Subject "Subject (any Obj)" ref="packages/core/echo/echo/src/Obj.ts"
  node RootFeed "Root feed (stage 2)" stroke=dashed ref="packages/core/echo/echo/src/Feed.ts"
  node Feed "Feed" ref="packages/core/echo/echo/src/Feed.ts"
  node Message "Message" ref="packages/sdk/types/src/types/Message.ts"
}
group review "plugin-review" {
  node Thread "Thread" ref="packages/sdk/types/src/types/Thread.ts"
  node AnchoredTo "AnchoredTo" ref="packages/sdk/types/src/types/AnchoredTo.ts"
  node Settings "Review Settings" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-review/src/types/Settings.ts"
  node Runner "Runner (toolkit)" ref="packages/sdk/app-toolkit/src/app-framework/AppCapabilities.ts"
}
group assistant "plugin-assistant" {
  node CommentRunner "Comment runner" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-assistant/src/capabilities/index.ts"
  node Chat "Chat" ref="packages/core/compute/assistant/src/types/Chat.ts"
  node Context "SubjectContext" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-assistant/src/types/AssistantCapabilities.ts"
  node AgentSvc "AgentService" ref="packages/core/compute/compute/src/AgentService.ts"
}
edge AnchoredTo -> Thread "source"
edge AnchoredTo -> Subject "target"
edge Thread composes Feed "feed"
edge Feed one-to-many Message "items"
edge Thread:bottom composes Chat:right "hidden chat"
edge Chat:bottom -> Feed:right "not owned" stroke=dashed
edge Chat -> Subject "bound subject"
edge Settings -> Thread "agent mode"
edge CommentRunner implements Runner
edge CommentRunner -> Chat "run turn"
edge Context -> Chat "binds skills"
edge AgentSvc -> Feed "appends replies"
edge Subject composes RootFeed stroke=dashed
edge RootFeed composes Feed "branch" stroke=dashed
"},"objects":[
